events.permanent_water_note: excluding_permanent_water subtracts the supplied permanent-water polygon (JRC_GSW_occurrence_v1_4_2021 (occurrence >= 75%)) from both predicted and reference geometries before scoring.
harness_notes: Post-event sensor is Sentinel-1 at 10 m — VERIFIED by reading the product's own source.dbf, not inferred from the activation page (which does not state it).

Layer of record is `observed_event_a`, NOT `maximumWaterExtentA` (this activation does not publish one). observed_event_a is the extent delineated at the acquisition instant rather than a cumulative maximum, so it is a SNAPSHOT: a prediction from imagery at a different date will disagree partly for TIMING reasons, not only accuracy reasons. This is a different reference semantics from Kanalia/Insh and must be stated whenever the numbers are compared.

Keramidi resolves as a zero-area OSM Point; boundary.py's _ensure_areal buffers it to a ~6 km disk — the SAME fallback the production pipeline already uses for point-only cities (Kanalia, Davao), not a harness-specific approximation.
Reference clipped to the buffered AOI is 15.069 km2 = 20.14% flooded fraction — a healthy partial-flood regime, not degenerate.

RURAL event (Pinios river tributaries, farmland). It does NOT close the urban-validation gap — see SCIENCE_LOG's 'Phase 7 — EMS reference ceiling'. The urban candidates found this session (Townsville, Verona, Sciacca) were all rejected: Townsville on sensor grounds (commercial VHR post-event), Verona and Sciacca on flooded fraction (2.66% and 0.62% of their densest AOI — Paiporta territory, where a perfect detector still scores near zero).
2018-02/03 predates Sentinel-2 L2A global availability in places; this event is scored on the S1 path, so that does not apply here.

DISAMBIGUATION (same class of bug as Kanalia's, caught before it could score): bare 'Keramidi, Greece' resolves to a DIFFERENT village — in the Municipal Unit of KANALIA, Rigas Feraios — which clips the reference to exactly 0.000 km2 and would have reported a misleading IoU of 0.0 as if it were a detector failure. 'Keramidi, Trikala, Greece' disambiguates to the intended village (Farkadona Municipality, Trikala) with 15.069 km2 of reference inside the AOI. Verified by direct Nominatim query 2026-07-29.

SATELLITE SELECTION FORCED to sentinel-1 for this run (tests/validation/forced_satellite_override.py) — this bypasses select_satellite's real cloud-aware decision entirely; the DB row's selection_reason will read 'harness_forced_selection', never a real selection_reason value, so this cannot be mistaken for an organically-selected result.
